description: Coding sandboxes for platforms: list the sandboxes this account created for its own users, filtered by end_user_id and/or tags (needs the platform API switched on for the account). State, end user, tags, pay-as-you-go billing and hold status. Read-only.

computeApiKey.description: Singularity compute API key (cloud.x402compute.cc → Settings → API Keys). Read scopes are enough.

endUserId.description: The platform's own id for its user (optional)

state.description: provisioning, awake, asleep, deleted, failed (comma separated) or all. Default: live ones

name: cloud_list_sandboxes
